nodes.summary: The conjecture is false: there exist a group $\Gamma$, a complete metric space $(M, d_1)$ on which $\Gamma$ acts, and a cocompact asymptotically equivalent length-space pair on $M$ with second metric $d_2$, such that for every real number $C$ there are points $x, y \in M$ with $|d_1(x, y) - d_2(x, y)| > C$.
nodes.title: Negative answer to the cocompact asymptotic-metrics question

nodes.summary: The statement that for every group $\Gamma$, every complete metric space $(M, d_1)$ on which $\Gamma$ acts, and every cocompact asymptotically equivalent length-space pair on $M$ with second metric $d_2$, there is a real number $C$ such that $|d_1(x, y) - d_2(x, y)| \le C$ for all $x, y \in M$.
nodes.title: Bounded-difference conjecture for cocompact asymptotically equivalent metrics

nodes.summary: Let $\Gamma$ be a group acting on a complete metric space $(M, d_1)$. A cocompact asymptotically equivalent length-space pair on $M$ is a function $d_2 \colon M \times M \to \mathbb{R}$ with the following properties.
